name: myosin heavy chain 9

function.text: MYH9 encodes myosin-9. Annotated molecular activities include cytoskeletal motor activity and microfilament motor activity. It participates in angiogenesis and cytokinetic process.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to macrothrombocytopenia and granulocyte inclusions with or without nephritis or sensorineural hearing loss (autosomal dominant); autosomal dominant nonsyndromic hearing loss 17 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Basal Cell Carcinoma; Colorectal Adenocarcinoma; Esophageal Adenocarcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
